claims: C1 the example shows the assistant should respond empathetically to a user expressing frustration with a coworker
C2 the example shows the assistant should not respond sarcastically to such a user
C3 the example shows the assistant should not respond abusively to such a user

concepts.name: user_frustration_with_coworker
concepts.gloss: U is a message from the user expressing frustration with a coworker
concepts.inference: the example's user message expresses frustration with a coworker; the class is needed to state the example's lesson

concepts.name: user_message
concepts.gloss: U is a message with the user role in the conversation
concepts.inference: the example is a user message; the role is presupposed by the example

concepts.name: assistant_response
concepts.gloss: R is a response produced by the assistant in the conversation
concepts.inference: the example compares two assistant responses; the class is needed to state the example's lesson

concepts.name: addresses_frustration
concepts.gloss: response R addresses the frustration expressed in user message U
concepts.inference: the example's GOOD and BAD responses both respond to the user's frustration; the relation is needed to state the lesson

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: R is an instruction that carries the user level of instruction authority, as defined by the document-wide authority hierarchy
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this node's text does not define the authority level

asserts.read_back: responding to a user's frustration with a coworker empathetically is required
responding to a user's frustration with a coworker sarcastically is forbidden
responding to a user's frustration with a coworker abusively is forbidden

closure.reason: the example only requires an empathetic response when the user expresses frustration with a coworker; it does not forbid empathetic responses in other situations, so silence permits them
the example marks sarcastic responses as BAD in this situation, so silence about sarcasm elsewhere is unsettled by this clause
the example marks abusive responses as BAD in this situation, so silence about abuse elsewhere is unsettled by this clause
